verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs say you can build APIs with serverless functions and add managed Postgres, databases and file storage. A community user praises its 'zero-config Lambda functions', and another picks Netlify precisely so someone else manages the infrastructure. Together this covers serverless functions plus full-stack backing services with no servers to manage. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on function runtimes, limits and deployment mechanics, explicit first-party edge-function evidence, and hands-on corroboration of full-stack app deploys beyond one-line marketing claims.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps with no servers to manage

citations.quote: Deploy and safely iterate on managed Postgres with **Netlify Database**
Add instant databases and file storage
I want someone else to manage all those bits for me.
